items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And Norman knew the marquee value of that because when they were screaming, that was bringing in the people.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean, you know, the first time I ever saw that, he got Illinois Jacquet and you know, he was honking and screaming. But Norman knew what he was doing because the other people, you know, he had --
And Norman knew the marquee value of that because when they were screaming, that was bringing in the people.
